components.rule: box top = a new high that is not touched or exceeded on the three following sessions; a touch (high equal to the candidate) or a higher high restarts the count
box bottom only after the top is established; reverse three-day procedure: a low not touched or undercut on the three following sessions; a re-touch restarts the count (#709 VU-DAR missing rule)
the three days confirm boundaries; there is no waiting period after the breakout (DAR-ARLAN)
buy-stop a fraction above the completed box top, executed on the breakthrough; fill = max(open, trigger)
initial stop a fraction below the broken box top; never inside the box
when a new higher box has both boundaries, raise the stop to a fraction below its bottom (never lower it); the new bottom need not equal the old top
all-time high is required: evidence ALL_TIME_HIGH_IN_AVAILABLE_HISTORY; when the history does not reach the listing date the flag is unverifiable and goes to review

the source says "a fraction" and does not quantify it; VU convention = one raw cent (0.01 / split factor), the same tick as V4 Turtle; the reviewer may set another fraction per trade (DAR-C-THIO: no automatic same fraction for all trades)
the bottom search starts on the first session after the top is confirmed (default) or after the top day; #709 VU-DAR records the start as UNRESOLVED, both are supported
a high above the confirmed top before the bottom is confirmed means no complete box yet: the top search restarts at that high
a low below the completed box bottom before a breakout dissolves the box; the top search restarts
volume of the candidate day > the highest down-day volume of the ten sessions before it (strictly greater)
a down day closes below the previous close; a window without a down day yields NO_DOWN_DAY_IN_WINDOW (no comparison, no candidate)
the candidate day itself closes above the previous close (a pivot is a buy point on strength); not stated numerically in #709
distance to the 10/50/200-day averages is reported; base quality, trend, V-shape, wedging and extension are reviewer judgments
exit guides (10DMA after >= 7 weeks of respect, else 50DMA; violation semantics differ by version) are preferences; not part of the detector
gap size >= 0.75 x ATR(40)
gap = open - previous close; the full gap (low - previous high) is reported as evidence
ATR(40) = simple mean of the true range over the 40 sessions before the gap day (no same-day information)
standard: gap-day volume >= 1.5 x average volume
below the standard the record is not rejected: VOLUME_BELOW_STANDARD_EXCEPTION_REVIEW (megacap exception is a reviewer decision)
average volume over the 50 sessions before the gap day; #709 does not state the averaging window (SOURCE GAP); the ratio is reported for the reviewer
gap-day low reported as the risk reference; not enforced
daily variant: evaluated with the full-day volume after the close; intraday projected volume is not available (intraday history DATA_BLOCKED)
unit = floor(0.01 x notional / (N x dollars per point))
equities: dollars per point = 1 per share; the V4 engine keeps fractional shares (floor not applied)
next unit 1/2 N above the previous ACTUAL fill, at most 4 units; several adds on one day are possible
each unit starts with a stop 2N below its own fill
every add raises the stops of all earlier units by 1/2 N; after a gapped add the units therefore carry different stops
optional Whipsaw stop variant (1/2 N unit stop, re-entry) is a separate OPTIONAL variant, not the default
